typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the characteristic high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs typical of the "Modern" or Didone style (such as Bodoni or Didot), which was prevalent in French academic publishing during the late 19th century.
